devdoc.details: The id is only unique within one registry deployment on one chain — off-chain consumers must key groups by (chainId, registryAddress, groupId). TRUST MODEL: attaching a group to a maker's admission policy via WhitelistPolicyV2.setGroups delegates ongoing admission policy to the group's controller set: the current curator, any future curator after transfer, and the current and any future resolver. Any of these can admit arbitrary accounts at any time. It also accepts the group's arbitrator, current or future, for intents a member signals through the group on OrchestratorV4: the arbitrator can release, partially release or cancel them without a payment proof.

params._name: Human-readable label, emitted in the event only (not stored).

params._arbitrator: Arbitrator for new intents signaled through the group (address(0) to clear).

params._newCurator: Proposed new curator (must be nonzero; cancellation is a dedicated function).

devdoc.title: AddressGroupRegistry

acceptGroupCurator(bytes32).notice: Completes a pending curator transfer. Callable only by the pending curator. The previous curator retains no access after acceptance.

addMembers(bytes32,address[]).notice: Adds members to a group. Idempotent: already-present members are skipped (no event).

createGroup(string).notice: Creates a new group curated by the caller, with an id derived from the curator and global counter.

getGroup(bytes32).notice: Returns a group's governance state for atomic inspection.

groupArbitrator(bytes32).notice: Returns the arbitrator for intents signaled through the group (address(0) when unset or the group does not exist).

groupCount().notice: Number of groups created (the counter used to derive group ids).

groupExists(bytes32).notice: Returns whether a group exists (input validation only — not a trust guarantee).

isMember(bytes32,address).notice: Returns whether an account is a member of a group (curated OR resolver). Returns false for nonexistent groups. Resolver failures fail closed for that resolver only — they never revert this call.

joinGroup(bytes32).notice: Joins a public group as the caller.

leaveGroup(bytes32).notice: Leaves a public group's curated membership as the caller.

removeMembers(bytes32,address[]).notice: Removes members from a group. Idempotent: absent members are skipped (no event).

setArbitrator(bytes32,address).notice: Sets or clears the group's arbitrator. Intents keep the arbitrator they were signaled with.

setGroupVisibility(bytes32,bool).notice: Sets whether a group permits self-service membership.

setResolver(bytes32,address).notice: Sets or clears the group's resolver. A nonzero resolver must have code; note this does not make upgradeable or malicious resolvers safe — the resolver is part of the group's trust surface.

transferGroupCurator(bytes32,address).notice: Starts a two-step curator transfer. Replaces any existing pending curator.

userdoc.notice: Permissionless registry of curator-managed address groups. Groups are identified by a bytes32 id derived as keccak256(abi.encode(curator, groupCount)) and are never deleted. Only the group curator mutates members and the resolver; shared control is achieved by using a multisig as the curator.
